messages:
maya: heads up — production tenant reported doubled token billing after a resume probe triggered a reconnect. they saw two short resumes back-to-back and both incremented quota.

rija: ugh. do we have repro logs? which probe did they hit (keepalive vs resume-check)?

maya: keepalive probe (we added the extra resume probe last month). sample log:
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:03Z] session=tn-42 event=probe sent X-Resume-Probe:1
[2026-03-15T14:22:03Z] session=tn-42 route=pool-east claim=sticky candidate=none
[2026-03-15T14:22:03Z] session=tn-42 event=resume request_id=req-7f3b token_count=12 billed=true
[2026-03-15T14:22:04Z] session=tn-42 event=resume request_id=req-7f3c token_count=12 billed=true
```

samir: looks like probe triggers an actual route/serve request that bubbles into billing. we intended probes to be no-op, just health checks. :grimacing:

kelsey: do we attach any auth/tenant headers for probes? billing pipeline currently charges on any authenticated generation request.

maya: probe includes Auth header because it's resuming session to validate KV cache. so infra treats it as a normal generation attempt.

rija: proposal: mark probe requests with `X-Resume-Probe: 1` and make the billing layer skip charging when that header is present and response is < 50 tokens and probe flag returned. but need to be careful with fraudulent headers if a tenant spoofs them.

samir: agree on header approach but enforce at proxy border (our edge) — only edge can set `X-Internal-Probe: 1` after validating the request is from our health subsystem. other paths can't set it. add a signed header or drop header if forwarded from client.

kelsey: another angle: keep probe as non-authorizing (anonymous) so it can't touch quota. But we rely on tenant context to find KV cache, so anonymous won't work.

telemetry-svc: telemetry note: there is currently no metric that differentiates probe-induced resumes from user resumes. we need `resume.reason=probe|user` in traces and the console dashboard to filter billing-impacting resumes.

maya: yes — customers are confused because console shows two resume events and charges, but they only see one user action in app. visibility fix is critical.

rija: operational checklist:
- edge: accept probe, add `X-Internal-Probe` and strip any client-supplied probe headers (samir)
- proxy: tag request with `resume.reason=probe` in trace/span (telemetry-svc)
- billing: ignore requests with internal-probe and token_count < 100 (kelsey)
- routing: ensure probe doesn't claim sticky lease or change session routing (maya)

samir: quick patch idea for routing: when request has probe header, run a lightweight KV check only — do not transition session state or update lease TTL. implementation: short-circuit `claimLease()` with `if (probe) return LeaseProbeResult`.

kelsey: tests needed: integration test that fires probe and ensures no billing, no lease change, and a subsequent real resume still works. also unit test for billing filter.

deploy-bot: Canary build queued: platform/probe-honor-header -> build 2345. will run canary in `staging` in 10m.

maya: for console UX we should add an optional toggle: "Show system probes" so customers can opt into seeing probe traffic in sessions timeline. default off. keeps console simpler for most.

telemetry-svc: will add `resume.probe_count` and `resume.user_count` to session analytics export. ETA: 2 days.

rija: security note: ensure sig on `X-Internal-Probe` header uses our edge key and is validated by backend. don't rely on plain header.

samir: I'll PR the routing short-circuit and the header validation. can someone own the billing exclusion? kelsey?

kelsey: on it. I'll open billing/PR and add the guard plus tests. also will coordinate with finance to replay the tenant's charges if needed.

maya: thanks — action owners: samir (routing), kelsey (billing + finance), telemetry-svc (metrics), rija (edge validation). I'll follow up with canary link once deploy-bot runs. :thumbsup:

riyaz: tiny nit — can we ensure probe traces carry `probe.phase=preclaim|postclaim` so we can debug ordering when things still double-charge?

telemetry-svc: good idea, added to backlog.

maya: last note — create a short postmortem blurb if finance issues refunds. keep messaging: "probe traffic shouldn't be billable; we're fixing header validation and adding visibility."

samir: PR opened: github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/842 — includes header strip + lease short-circuit. PTAL.

kelsey: PR opened: github.com/redwood/billing/pull/576 — billing skip for validated internal probes. includes tests.

maya: moving to follow-up thread for canary results. thanks everyone.
